scripts.rasa: cd .. && rasa_env\Scripts\activate && cd chatbot && rasa run --enable-api --debug --cors *
scripts.rasa train: cd .. && rasa_env\Scripts\activate && cd chatbot && rasa train
scripts.actions: cd .. && rasa_env\Scripts\activate && cd chatbot && watchmedo auto-restart --patterns="*.py" --recursive -- rasa run actions
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run rasa" "npm run actions" "npm run backend" "npm run mlservice" "npm run frontend"
